content:
1/2 ripe melon of your choice, roughly chopped

Blend the chopped melon well in a blender. Add a little water if necessary to get the blending process started. Add a touch of your favorite spice, such as cinnamon, cardamom, clove or ginger, if desired. Serve immediately.
